Name: Hyper Realistic Coins - Dynamic Game Assets Conversion
Author: GaLaxY256
Description:
[size=3][size=3]Pelican Town is famous enough to get its own type of currency.
(This will change money icon which you can see in main menu/shop menu and reward icon which you can see in quest logs.)

[font=Georgia]This mod is originally made by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/12004908]undare[/url] and converted to DGA format by me. Please check and endorse the original [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6686]mod[/url], too!
This mod is uploaded with permission from the original author.[/font]

[font=Georgia]Why should I use Dynamic Game Assets instead of Content Patcher Animations?
[list]
[*] ﻿Content Patcher Animations has been marked deprecated and has been replaced by DGA.
[*] CPA mods affect your frame rate and thus can cause stutters depending your device's specs. DGA doesn't affect that much of your game's performance compared to CPA.
[*] Probably even more, like adding new items (Since DGA is successor of Json Assets).
[/list][/font]

[/size][/size]--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[b][font=Georgia]INSTALLATION:
[/font][/b]
[list=1]
[*][size=3] Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9365]Dynamic Game Assets[/url] and its requirements. ([b]Optional[/b]: install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url])﻿[/size]
[*][size=3] Download this mod, unzip the file and put in inside [font=Courier New]Mods[/font] ﻿folder. ([b]Optional:[/b] Download and install the optional Change the UI m)[/size]
[*][size=3] ﻿﻿Edit the config as you like and enjoy the new icons![/size]
[/list]
[b][font=Georgia]CONFIGURATION:

﻿﻿ ﻿[/font][/b][size=3]This mod has config options available which you can modify either by editing config.json (which is generated after running the game first time with mod installed) or by using GMCM. You can modify the following values:

[/size][list]
[size=3] ﻿﻿[b]Animated Coin Variant[/b]: Decides which variant of coin you want to use for the game. You can use either one of eight available options.
[/size][size=4] [/size][code]﻿Basic_gold, Flowers_and_rivers_gold, Polished,Junimo_gold, junimo_rare_gold, refined_silver, refined_junimo_silver, tacos
[/code][size=4] ﻿ [/size][size=3]﻿
﻿ ﻿[b]Include Pile Animations: [/b]Whether you also want to enable reward icon (which is seen in quest logs). The variant will change automatically based on which coin variant you chose above. This only have two options to choose:[/size][code]﻿True, False
[/code][/list][b][font=Georgia]
[size=2]OPTIONAL CHANGE THE UI ADDON:[/size][/font][/b]

﻿ ﻿ ﻿[size=3]Installing this will also change the letter "G" seen in in-game UI and end of the day UI to "S" (silver) or "T" (Tacos). Supports vanilla, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6166]Overgrown Flowery Interface[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6654]Vintage Interface Multipack[/url]﻿. You may need to modify the following config values before playing: 
[list]
[*] [size=3] [b]Coin Format: [/b]Changes the letter to "S" or "T" depending on what you chose here. (Options: Gold [no change], Silver, Tacos)[/size]
[*] [size=3] [b]Vintage Theme: [/b](Only change this if you use VIM) Change this to fit with the Vintage theme you're using. Other interfaces user﻿s don't need to change this as it will be applied automaticaclly.[/size]
[/list][/size][b][font=Georgia]
[size=3]COMPATIBILITIES:

﻿ ﻿ ﻿[/size][/font][/b][size=3]Should be compatible with mods that doesn't change the icons this mod offers. If you see any incompatibilities, please let me know. :)[/size]
